nodes.label: Vocab Flow Backend FULL SPEC v0.4
Collection -> Topic -> Word -> Type -> Meaning hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Progress is unique per (user, meaning) even when a Meaning appears in several Topics.

nodes.label: Daily Session (Review Due -> Learn New -> Active Recall -> Finish)
All-or-nothing session semantics
nodes.rationale: Abandon before Finish never updates learning; only a successful backend commit sets learnedAt, review progress and evidence.

nodes.label: select template
nodes.rationale: Single correctOptionId evaluator shared by gloss, phoneticChoice, stressChoice variants.

nodes.label: clozeSelect template
nodes.rationale: Choose one option for a single blank; not full-sentence tile reordering.

nodes.label: flyReorder template
nodes.rationale: Grapheme tiles with stable integer IDs; server replays ordered tileIds rather than trusting the rendered string.

nodes.label: typing.transcription variant (replaces audio trace)
nodes.rationale: Transcription of heard English is not semantic recall.

nodes.label: Retired templates audioSelect / split / trace
nodes.rationale: Banned in v0.4 issuance; legacy snapshots need a versioned reader.

nodes.label: Universal prompt envelope (text | audio)
nodes.rationale: Template defines interaction; prompt.type only defines stimulus modality; exactly one primary prompt mode per task.

nodes.label: prompt.type is not a skill mapping
nodes.rationale: Skill is derived from assessment intent + target + reply type + delivered mode + hints, not prompt modality alone.

nodes.label: Practice Resolver (resolve task)
nodes.rationale: Fails closed: no runtime machine translation, no fake audio URLs.

nodes.label: Localization pipeline (template copy + published vocab locale + curated item locale)
Client contract: minimal but complete task payload
nodes.rationale: Task never exposes wordId/meaningId/targets; client grades locally without querying Meaning.

nodes.label: Generated + Curated practice content
nodes.rationale: No N x 7 rows on import; Generated tasks persisted only as session snapshots.

nodes.label: Dual-target mapping (Meaning + Pronunciation)
nodes.rationale: select(audio) may yield Meaning memory and Listening evidence; both IDs must belong to the same Word/Type.

nodes.label: app_user.proficiency_level
nodes.rationale: Only one column, no placement tables; orders new Meanings by CEFR and gates contextual items.

nodes.label: Contextual gating (context_cefr_level <= proficiency_level)
nodes.rationale: Avoid puzzling beginners with contextual questions above their level.

nodes.label: New Meaning Learning Cycle (select + typing|flyReorder + recording)
Interleaving of practice across Meanings
nodes.rationale: Avoid the answer appearing right before Meaning-cued recall (priming).

nodes.label: Publication rules (Meaning x locale immutable snapshot)
meaning_publications / active_meaning_publications tables
nodes.rationale: Runtime resolves only from published snapshots, never mutable drafts.

nodes.label: practice_items (+ localizations, targets) tables
nodes.rationale: One table for curated items of every template; each row is an immutable content revision via supersedes_item_id.

nodes.label: learning_sessions table (plan, raw_events, result)
nodes.rationale: Issued != committed; plan immutable, only retention may NULL it; result kept long-term.

nodes.label: speech_assessment_receipts table
nodes.rationale: Temporary technical staging; no learning evidence before Finish.

nodes.label: Index policy (B-tree first, GIN only if needed)
Commit body (raw events only, deliveryMode)
nodes.rationale: Client never asserts correct/skill/meaningId; backend replays events against immutable snapshot.

nodes.label: Result reducer (task -> target -> MemoryObservation + SkillEvidence)
nodes.rationale: At most one MemoryObservation per Meaning per session; recall outranks recognition.

nodes.label: Mode-specific SRS policy (superseded by FSRS-6)
nodes.rationale: Non-daily success does not extend SRS to prevent success farming.

nodes.label: Recognition Grace
nodes.rationale: Recognition-only reviews cannot postpone due forever; grace used once.

nodes.label: Atomic commit algorithm
nodes.rationale: Single transaction, per-user lock, server replay; never call Azure inside the transaction.

nodes.label: Idempotency via sessionId + SHA-256 canonical request
Per-user commit serialization (row lock / advisory lock)
Trust boundary: client holds answer key
nodes.rationale: Replay improves consistency but cannot prove honesty; high-stakes would need a different architecture.

nodes.label: Checkpoint Challenge (every 7 new-learning sessions)
nodes.rationale: Counted per session, not per calendar day; created inside commit transaction.

nodes.label: Azure Pronunciation Assessment adapter
nodes.rationale: Invalid/unavailable audio is not a Speaking failure; AccuracyScore >= 80 trial threshold.

nodes.label: Custom word appendix
nodes.rationale: Learner content stays private; AI meanings shared only after admin approval of stored AI text.
